_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

An Unexpected Departure#001.src: This plaque has clearly seen erosion over time, but you can still make out most of the text.
An Unexpected Departure#001.dst: Эта табличка явно пострадала от времени, но большую часть текста ещё можно разобрать.

An Unexpected Departure#002.src: "This monument has been built in memory of those who perished following a terrible attack initiated by enemies of the state."
An Unexpected Departure#002.dst: «Этот памятник воздвигнут в память о тех, кто погиб после ужасного нападения, устроенного врагами государства.»

An Unexpected Departure#003.src: "Forever shall the workers have strength, and rise above those who wish to destroy our glorious way of life."
An Unexpected Departure#003.dst: «Да пребудет вечно сила рабочих, и да возвысятся они над теми, кто желает разрушить наш славный уклад жизни.»

An Unexpected Departure#004.src: The rake collides with the statue, damaging it a bit.
An Unexpected Departure#004.dst: Грабли ударяются о статую и слегка её повреждают.

An Unexpected Departure#007.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the log.

An Unexpected Departure#008.src: The rope starts to fray, adding any more weight will make it snap.
An Unexpected Departure#008.dst: Верёвка начинает перетираться: если добавить ещё хоть немного веса, она лопнет.

An Unexpected Departure#009.src: It looks like there's enough space in this to fit at least three items.
An Unexpected Departure#009.dst: Похоже, сюда поместятся как минимум три предмета.

An Unexpected Departure#010.src: The guards have found our position. We must make our escape sooner than originally planned.
An Unexpected Departure#010.dst: Стража обнаружила наше укрытие. Придётся бежать раньше, чем мы планировали.
An Unexpected Departure#010.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#011.src: There is little time left, gather everything you need and board the escape craft. Now!
An Unexpected Departure#011.dst: Времени почти не осталось. Собери всё необходимое и садись в аппарат для побега. Живо!
An Unexpected Departure#011.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#012.src: They found us. One of our members was caught smuggling supplies for the escape.
An Unexpected Departure#012.dst: Нас нашли. Одного из наших поймали на контрабанде припасов для побега.

An Unexpected Departure#013.src: We cannot prepare for any longer. We must leave immediately.
An Unexpected Departure#013.dst: Готовиться дальше мы не можем. Нужно уходить немедленно.

An Unexpected Departure#014.src: As the night approaches, so does our last day in these hopeless lands.
An Unexpected Departure#014.dst: С приближением ночи приближается и наш последний день в этих безнадёжных землях.

An Unexpected Departure#015.src: We are almost ready, there are only a few final improvements we must add to our escape craft.
An Unexpected Departure#015.dst: Мы почти готовы, осталось внести в аппарат для побега лишь несколько последних доработок.

An Unexpected Departure#016.src: If we fail to escape, it will mean almost certain death for us.
An Unexpected Departure#016.dst: Если побег не удастся, нас почти наверняка ждёт смерть.

An Unexpected Departure#017.src:
Finnegan
I need to bring that book!
An Unexpected Departure#017.dst:
Finnegan
Мне нужно взять ту книгу!
An Unexpected Departure#017.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#019.src:
Rella
Hurry up! The craft is ready.
An Unexpected Departure#019.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#020.src:
Capulus
There's no way they found us!
An Unexpected Departure#020.dst:
Capulus
Не может быть, чтобы нас нашли!
An Unexpected Departure#020.speaker: Capulus

An Unexpected Departure#021.src:
Oliver
I hope this launcher works.
An Unexpected Departure#021.dst:
Oliver
Надеюсь, эта пусковая установка сработает.
An Unexpected Departure#021.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#022.src:
Tony
I was enjoying that sandwich...
An Unexpected Departure#022.dst:
Tony
А я так наслаждался тем бутербродом...
An Unexpected Departure#022.speaker: Tony

An Unexpected Departure#023.src:
Eris
We didn't even finalize the design...
An Unexpected Departure#023.dst:
Eris
Мы даже не доработали конструкцию...
An Unexpected Departure#023.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#024.src:
Capulus
We don't have much time!
An Unexpected Departure#024.speaker: Capulus

An Unexpected Departure#025.src:
Eris
It should still work... right?
An Unexpected Departure#025.dst:
Eris
Оно ведь всё равно должно сработать... правда?
An Unexpected Departure#025.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#026.src:
Rella
No need to dwell on the design. We're leaving.
An Unexpected Departure#026.dst:
Rella
Нечего зацикливаться на конструкции. Мы улетаем.
An Unexpected Departure#026.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#027.dst:
Oliver
Да это даже не сработает...
An Unexpected Departure#027.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#029.src:
Lynn
Can't wait to get out of this awful place.
An Unexpected Departure#029.dst:
Lynn
Не терпится выбраться из этого ужасного места.
An Unexpected Departure#029.speaker: Lynn

An Unexpected Departure#030.src:
Tony
Should make sure this beam doesn't break.
An Unexpected Departure#030.dst:
Tony
Надо проследить, чтобы эта балка не сломалась.
An Unexpected Departure#030.speaker: Tony

An Unexpected Departure#031.src:
Eris
I think I forgot my wrench.
An Unexpected Departure#031.dst:
Eris
Кажется, гаечный ключ остался дома.
An Unexpected Departure#031.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#032.src:
Finnegan
Dammit! Where did I put that book?
An Unexpected Departure#032.dst:
Finnegan
Чёрт! Куда я дел ту книгу?
An Unexpected Departure#032.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#034.src:
Rella
Pack up what you can!
An Unexpected Departure#034.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#035.src:
Lynn
Just need to get a few final supplies...
An Unexpected Departure#035.dst:
Lynn
Осталось только собрать последние припасы...
An Unexpected Departure#035.speaker: Lynn

An Unexpected Departure#037.src:
Eris
They can't possibly catch us.
An Unexpected Departure#037.dst:
Eris
Им ни за что нас не поймать.
An Unexpected Departure#037.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#038.src:
Rella
You don't need that book. Come already!
An Unexpected Departure#038.dst:
Rella
Не нужна тебе эта книга. Иди уже!
An Unexpected Departure#038.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#040.src:
Finnegan
I'm running out of time!
An Unexpected Departure#040.dst:
Finnegan
У меня почти не осталось времени!
An Unexpected Departure#040.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#042.src:
Oliver
We can't stay here for long.
An Unexpected Departure#042.dst:
Oliver
Долго мы здесь оставаться не можем.
An Unexpected Departure#042.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#043.src: "Stolen fabric from nearby factories. Must be strong and heat resistant."
An Unexpected Departure#043.dst: «Ткань, украденная с ближайших фабрик. Должна быть прочной и жаростойкой.»

An Unexpected Departure#044.src: "Fabric will be cut into strips, which will then be connected to form the balloon."
An Unexpected Departure#044.dst: «Ткань разрежут на полосы, которые затем соединят в оболочку шара.»

An Unexpected Departure#046.src: "Possible design for a burner. Must be facing up into the balloon, and will likely last at least {~} minutes."
An Unexpected Departure#046.dst: «Возможная конструкция горелки. Должна быть направлена вверх, внутрь шара; скорее всего, проработает не меньше {~} мин.»

An Unexpected Departure#047.src: "Will create hot air that rises into the balloon, which should provide enough lift to allow the craft to ascend."
An Unexpected Departure#047.dst: «Будет создавать горячий воздух, который поднимется в шар; подъёмной силы должно хватить, чтобы аппарат взлетел.»

An Unexpected Departure#048.src: The following text looks like a set of instructions for creating this device, but it appears to have been torn apart.
An Unexpected Departure#048.dst: Текст ниже похож на инструкцию по сборке этого устройства, но, судя по всему, его разорвали на части.

An Unexpected Departure#049.src: Everyone is clearly stressed- including me. There is much packing we must do before we leave.
An Unexpected Departure#049.dst: Все явно на нервах - и я тоже. Перед отлётом нам ещё многое нужно упаковать.

An Unexpected Departure#050.src: Most of the blueprint has been ripped or faded, but you can make out a vague balloon shape.
An Unexpected Departure#050.dst: Большая часть чертежа порвана или выцвела, но можно различить смутные очертания воздушного шара.

An Unexpected Departure#051.src: But we are ready: the explosive is primed, the route's been reviewed multiple times. There's no going back now.
An Unexpected Departure#051.dst: Но мы готовы: заряд готов к подрыву, маршрут проверен много раз. Пути назад уже нет.

An Unexpected Departure#052.src: Will we succeed? I pray we do. Failure will most certainly lead to our execution.
An Unexpected Departure#052.dst: Получится ли у нас? Молюсь, чтобы получилось. Провал почти наверняка означает казнь.

An Unexpected Departure#053.src: There is one thing for sure: No matter the result, it will have been a valiant attempt.
An Unexpected Departure#053.dst: Одно ясно наверняка: каким бы ни был итог, это будет доблестная попытка.

An Unexpected Departure#056.src: We've been waiting for this moment our entire lives. A chance to escape oppression. A chance to start out fresh.
An Unexpected Departure#056.dst: Мы ждали этого момента всю жизнь. Шанс вырваться из-под гнёта. Шанс начать всё заново.
An Unexpected Departure#056.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#057.dst: Но если у нас не выйдет...
An Unexpected Departure#057.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#058.src: We will be subject to the worst of the Queen's punishments.
An Unexpected Departure#058.dst: Нас ждут самые страшные кары Королевы.
An Unexpected Departure#058.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#060.src: We will never be allowed back here.
An Unexpected Departure#060.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#061.src: I can hear the guards approaching. It's time to leave.
An Unexpected Departure#061.dst: Я слышу, как приближается стража. Пора улетать.
An Unexpected Departure#061.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#069.src:
Markus
We will create a great province.
An Unexpected Departure#069.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#070.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the rock.

An Unexpected Departure#071.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the pot.
